company_name: The University of Tokyo, Koseki-Ohnishi Laboratory
semiconductor_relevance: High — The University of Tokyo's Koseki-Ohnishi Laboratory focuses on advanced control systems for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, which is critical for improving manufacturing efficiency and precision.
summary: The Koseki-Ohnishi Laboratory at The University of Tokyo specializes in optimizing mechatronics control for semiconductor manufacturing processes. Their research includes motor design, control systems for temperature and fluid management, and the development of high-speed, high-precision components aimed at enhancing manufacturing performance.
capabilities: Motor design and driver control for semiconductor equipment
Feedback and feedforward control system design
Iterative learning control for wafer processing
